comments.story: Mind reading technology: helmet aims to unlock brain's secrets
comments.why: Bryan Johnson discusses Kernel's Flow helmet and its IR sensing
comments.text: Johnson was on the Lex Fridman podcast recent and discussed the helmet there: [VIDEO] The most interesting thing is that one of their helmets, Flow, is using IR backscatter sensing rather than the electric or magnetic sensing that most other BCI devices (including their other helmet, Flux) use. The system is still pricey at $50-100k or $3.6k/mo, but they're also planning on selling a simplified version at $5k: [LINK]
